correctness.rationale: Separability of the vertex algebra and J²=0 identify normalized derivations as direct sum m copies gl2, modulo scalar vertex-incidence coboundaries D of dimension |V|-c. Nonscalar 2x2 matrices have 2-dimensional centralizers, giving C0=q^6+q^5-q^3. Characteristic two trace pairing gives C_t=q^3(q²-1) for nonzero scalar t and C0-C_t=q^6; in odd characteristic scalar nonzero commutator is impossible by trace. Averaging over vertex potentials then expanding edge equalities yields the displayed Tutte/random-cluster sum q^(-c-8m) Σ_{S} q^{κ(S)} C_t^{m-|S|}q^{6|S|}. Independently enumerated q=2 and q=3 matrix commutators, including C0(2)=88, C1(2)=24, C0(3)=945, and counted q=2 forest=343/4096 versus triangle=407/8192. The all-q/all-G proof is algebraic, not extrapolated.
residual_risks: Derived Lie quotient uses finite loopless J²=0 quivers with exactly two arrows per nonempty ordered class; loops or other multiplicities excluded.
Only q=2,3 finite tests were independently rerun; general proof relies on linear algebra and finite-field counting.
